key.name: override-results-order
key.description: Whether to override the default search results order to prioritize JetBrains projects. Requires disabling and re-enabling the extension to take effect.

key.name: show-ide-name
key.description: Whether to show the IDE name next to the project name in search results.

key.name: max-projects
key.description: Maximum number of recent projects to show for each IDE.
